mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "List" scrapes one of ARMP's public Journal des Marches Publics listing views (paginated). "Detail" fetches the full text of specific publications you already know.

listType.title: List type (mode=list only)
listType.description: Which ARMP listing to scrape. "Latest" mixes every publication type (notices, addenda, award decisions, award communiques) in one reverse-chronological feed. The others each filter to one procurement category (counts as of 2026-08-27).

maxResults.title: Max results (mode=list only)
maxResults.description: Caps how many rows are scraped for this run, across as many pages as needed (10 rows per page server-side). "Latest" and "national" can have thousands of total rows -- raise this only as high as you actually need.

resourceId.title: Publication ID or URL (mode=detail only)
resourceId.description: A single ARMP publication, as either its full detail URL, or a "TYPE:ID" pair (e.g. "AO:64638") -- both found in a 'list' mode run's detailsUrl/typePublication/idPublication fields.

resourceIds.title: Publication IDs or URLs (mode=detail only)
resourceIds.description: Multiple publications (full detail URLs, or "TYPE:ID" pairs) to fetch full detail for in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (mode=detail only)
maxConcurrency.description: How many publication detail pages to fetch in parallel.
